narrative_prose: [MIDDAY_EXPEDITION at The_First_Forge] Hector caught the heavy brass data-cylinder, the residual heat of the forge searing pleasantly through his insulated grips. Outside the thick quartz viewport, the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea whipped the magnetic ocean into terrifying, jagged peaks, demanding immediate attention to keep the structure sound. He moved fast to DEFEND the oscillating resonance chamber from micro-fractures, tapped the cooling slag vents to CONSUME excess thermal energy, and slammed shut the heavy blast doors to CONCEAL their vulnerable diagnostics from the rising pressure wave. With the localized crisis momentarily stabilized, he turned and tossed the baton—the physical cylinder now glowing with encoded telemetry—directly to Kaio, who was already gearing up for a scout run.
